name: Nile River Fluvial Trunk Route
primary_mode: Fluvial reed boats, wooden river barges, and sailboats
seasonality: Northbound drift with current year-round; southbound return powered by prevailing northern Mediterranean winds
critical_cargo: Basalt and granite building blocks from Aswan
Bulk agricultural grain from Upper Egypt
Fine ceramic wares and limestone masonry from Memphis
chokepoints: Low water seasonal shoals in spring prior to the summer flood

name: Wadi Hammamat Desert Caravan Corridor
seasonality: Winter and autumn; avoid extreme midsummer desert heat
critical_cargo: Bekhen-stone (greywacke) for carved statuary and cosmetic palettes
Alluvial gold and copper ingots from Eastern Desert veins
Frankincense and myrrh imported from Punt via Red Sea maritime landing
chokepoints: Desert well spacing requiring continuous water supply maintenance
Vulnerability to nomadic raiders along isolated wadi gorges

name: Levantine and Eastern Mediterranean Maritime Circuit
seasonality: April to October; winter Mediterranean storms prevent safe navigation
critical_cargo: Cedar and fir structural timber from Mount Lebanon
Cassiterite tin ingots and silver from Anatolia and Mediterranean intermediaries
Olive oil and wine in sealed amphorae
chokepoints: Delta river mouth silting and sandbars

name: Modern Transoceanic Maritime and Air Freight Network
destination: Industrial semiconductor and aerospace fabrication clusters
primary_mode: Container vessels, ultra-large crude carriers (ULCC), and cargo jetliners
seasonality: Continuous 24/7 all-weather operations via GPS and radar navigation
critical_cargo: Electronic-grade silicon ingots and processed semiconductor wafers
Lithium battery cathode powders and rare earth magnets
Precision CNC machine tools and optics
chokepoints: Suez Canal, Strait of Malacca, Strait of Hormuz, Panama Canal
Geopolitical export controls on dual-use aerospace and semiconductor technology
